theme_concept: Luxury, Modern, Premium, Elegant, Feminine, Professional. Focus on Premium Black backgrounds with Light Pink accents. The feel should be exclusive, utilizing generous negative space, high contrast between dark backgrounds and soft pink highlights, and crisp sans-serif/serif typography pairing. Deep charcoal cards with subtle soft borders to build depth without clutter.

headings.usage: Use for all major section headings (H1, H2, H3) and Hero titles. Adds the premium, feminine, and elegant editorial feel.

body.usage: Use for body text, inputs, buttons, and dashboard data. Crisp, modern, and highly legible.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first design. All default classes apply to mobile. Use sm:, md:, lg: prefixes for larger screens.
responsive.layout: Mobile uses stacked elements and a fixed bottom navigation bar for the customer side. Desktop uses multi-column bento grids and a sidebar for the admin panel.
responsive.typography: Fluid typography or stepped scaling. H1 starts at text-4xl on mobile, scales to text-6xl on desktop.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-hidden on the main wrapper to prevent horizontal scrolling.
responsive.tap_targets: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, nav items) have a minimum height and width of 44px on mobile.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for containers. Let the dark theme breathe.

grid_system.marketing: Bento grids with gap-6 to gap-12. Asymmetrical column spans (e.g. col-span-12 md:col-span-8).
grid_system.dashboard: High density, gap-4 to gap-6. Strict layout.

spacing_and_layout.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom navigation (Home, Services, Bookings, Profile) with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#141414]/90 border-t border-white/5). Must have z-50.
spacing_and_layout.desktop_nav: Sticky header with glassmorphism (bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-md) and border-b border-border.

surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, mobile bottom nav, and floating modals. bg-black/60 or bg-[#141414]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-white/10.
surface_strategies.cards: Solid charcoal (#141414) with 1px subtle border (border-white/5) and gentle shadow (shadow-2xl shadow-black/50). Rounded corners (rounded-2xl).
surface_strategies.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary marketing CTAs, slightly rounded (rounded-lg) for dashboard actions.

components.libraries: Shadcn UI (customized), Framer Motion, Lucide React (or Phosphor Icons if installed).

specific_rules.buttons: Primary buttons use #E8A2A8 (Light Pink) with black text. Hover state must transition smoothly.
specific_rules.inputs: Dark background (#141414), border (#262626), focus ring with primary color.
specific_rules.booking_wizard: Use stepped progress indicator. Each step should animate in using Framer Motion (fade and slight translate-y).
specific_rules.admin_sidebar: Fixed on desktop, hamburger menu driving a Sheet component on mobile.
specific_rules.tabs: Used for 'Upcoming/Completed/Cancelled' bookings. Customized to look like pill toggles or animated underbars.

hero_bridal.description: Elegant bridal makeup portrait. Use in Hero section with a dark gradient overlay (bg-black/40) to ensure text contrast.

hero_alternative.description: Woman in red and gold sari dress. Perfect for Bridal Service category card.

salon_interior.description: Luxury salon interior. Use as a background for the 'Explore Services' section with a heavy black overlay, or in the Gallery.

service_spa.description: Relaxing spa massage. Use for Spa service category.

service_makeup_academy.description: Close up makeup brushes. Use for Academy section or general Makeup service.

service_nails.description: Pink manicure. Use for Nails service category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for mobile-first. Construct the bottom navigation bar (`fixed bottom-0 w-full`) and ensure main content has padding-bottom so it's not hidden behind the nav.

Enforce the Dark Luxury theme. The background MUST be #050505 or #0A0A0A. Cards should be #141414. Do NOT use bright or cheap gradients. Use primary pink (#E8A2A8) exclusively for CTAs, active states, and accents.
Typography MUST use 'Playfair Display' for Headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Headings must have tight tracking.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header or bottom nav. Always use `backdrop-blur-xl` coupled with a semi-transparent color like `bg-[#050505]/80`.
For the Hero image, apply a gradient overlay like `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/50 to-transparent` so white text stands out perfectly.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, booking steps).
Use Framer Motion to add subtle entrance animations (e.g., `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`) to service cards and booking steps.
For admin dashboard, keep it in the same dark theme but utilize dense Shadcn UI components. Admin cards should be #141414 with white/muted text.
Do not use TSX. Create standard Javascript (.jsx/.js) files as per the project setup.
Avoid standard Vercel/Stripe looking components for the marketing page. Ensure components feel bespoke, feminine, and high-end.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadow boundaries.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped (for marketing) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use Lucide React.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use `sonner` for toasts. It is located at `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or `.jsx`.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Do not build Shadcn logic from scratch.
